author: CrashCourse
description:
Why don’t more people in the U.S. vote? In 2024, 90 million U.S. voters made a choice on election day…the choice not to vote. The U.S. has some of the lowest voter turnout of any developed democracy. To find the answer, we have to take a hard look at ourselves, but also at the systems that make us want to vote, or stay home. 

Chapter 1 - Introduction: Non-Voters 00:00
Chapter 2 - Voter Turnout 01:27
Chapter 3 - Are Voters to Blame? 04:01
Chapter 4 - Is the system to blame? 07:56
